intent.proves: Every email (not a template) points at a content page.

bindings.reason: Handler not reserved: needs a field-predicate projection over the tool's rows; mcp-count counts rows only. Predicate: pageId = 0.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(EmailId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + ISNULL(EmailName, N'') FROM EmailMarketingEmail WHERE ISNULL(EmailIsTemplate, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(EmailPageId, 0) = 0
